The plain-language version

Longer-running delivery with fewer human restarts.

Hermes watches the project and starts the next authorized piece of work. PM gives each session the project method. Ringer sends bounded work to the appropriate CLI and accepts it only when the declared check passes. Every handoff leaves evidence another seat can inspect.
